description: Base64 encode and decode text instantly, with full Unicode support. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

action.description: encode turns text into Base64; decode turns Base64 back into UTF-8 text. Defaults to encode.

text.description: The text to encode, or the Base64 to decode, depending on action. Encoding goes through UTF-8 first, so accents, emoji and CJK survive. Decoding accepts standard or URL-safe Base64, with or without padding, and ignores whitespace.

urlSafe.description: When encoding, use the URL-safe alphabet (RFC 4648 section 5): + and / become - and _, and the = padding is dropped, as in JWTs. Ignored when decoding, which detects either alphabet.

name: base64
title: Base64 Encoder & Decoder
